attributes.axis_log: (1) IMPROVING, KEPT: single-use temp elimination. Source had 'chunk_ofs = ofs + 4; if (ReadF32LE(param_2 + chunk_ofs) != 0x66727473)' -- chunk_ofs is used exactly once, immediately after assignment, feeding directly into a call-argument address expression with no other reference in the function. This forced our compile to materialize the value through an r0 scratch register then move-into-r3, where target builds param_2+ofs+4 directly into r3 in one step. Inlining to 'if (ReadF32LE(param_2 + ofs + 4) != 0x66727473)' (removing the chunk_ofs local entirely) took real 80->76 with insns held exactly 204/204. This matches claim.law.point-of-use-single-use-pointer-delay's pattern (single-use value, point-of-use computation beats a named intermediate). (2) NEUTRAL: reparenthesizing 'q = param_2 + (u32)ofs + 0xC;' to 'q = param_2 + ((u32)ofs + 0xC);' -- zero effect, reverted; MWCC canonicalizes this addition identically regardless of source grouping. (3) NEGATIVE x2, same axis, tried both before and after the chunk_ofs win to rule out interaction: declaring local 'p' before 'q' (source originally declares q, ofs, strl, [chunk_ofs], p in that order) regressed real 80->92 pre-fix and 76->90 post-fix. The mismatched register pair -- target gives the first 'p' assignment register r30 and reuses r29 for the later q-chain (feeding the 0x194 and 0xE8 field-write blocks); ours gives 'p' r27 (shared with the 'strl' local) and the q-chain r30 instead -- did not respond to declaration-order changes in either direction. (4) NEGATIVE: splitting the chained assignment 'p = (q = param_2 + ofs) + 4;' into two separate statements ('q = param_2 + ofs; p = q + 4;') regressed real 76->101 AND changed the insn count itself (204/204 -> 204/205) -- the chained form is load-bearing for both bytes and structure; reverted immediately.
